decision_notes: Thresholds manually reviewed using the WT v2 resequenced QC distributions. The RNA minimum was reduced from the automated suggestion of 500 to 300 because 92.6% of nuclei with 300-499 RNA UMIs passed the 250-feature requirement and 80.7% passed all other evaluated QC criteria, whereas only 16.4% of nuclei below 300 UMIs passed the feature requirement. The ATAC minimum was reduced from 1000 to 500 because nuclei with 500-999 ATAC counts had a median TSS enrichment of 7.89, 99.9% passed the TSS requirement, 100% passed the FRiP and nucleosome-signal requirements, and 87.1% were classified as singlets; this retained 689 additional nuclei that passed all other criteria. The sample-aware upper RNA, feature, and ATAC limits were retained after visual review, while the mitochondrial, TSS-enrichment, nucleosome-signal, and FRiP thresholds were retained as broad quality bounds.
